description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for retrieving the current date and time within the OrangeHRM attendance module. It implements the 'ResourceEndpoint' interface and extends 'Endpoint', providing a 'GET' method to return the current UTC date-time as a model. The class utilizes traits and services for date-time handling and is equipped with Swagger annotations for API documentation.
